desc:
A relaxing building game
Note: This is a sandbox game! There is no objective besides building - don't buy the game if you're expecting something else

Features:
- Hexagon grid building for ground, lakes, bridges and waterfalls
- Freeform building for plants, rocks, and other decorations
- Walls, ceilings, and roofs to create buildings
- Dynamic wind and grass
- Day/night cycle
- Saving and loading
- Multiplayer building and server discovery

Currently disabled for mobile and console, but planning on adding on release

Controls:
WASD - Move camera
Q/E - Move camera up and down
Shift - Slow camera down
Ctrl - Speed camera up
Mouse Wheel / Arrow Keys - Rotate blueprints
C - Open build menu
V - Switch to destroy mode
F - Switch decoration variant
G - Switch to grid snapping mode
H / Numpad Keys - Switch hotbar presets

Credits:

UI SFX by JDSherbert
